title: Evidence findings 1.0.0 - what the outside auditor returns about the evidence
description: The second outside-model call of a sitting (owner ruling AC2). A genuinely different model reads the evidence BEFORE any seat is paid and names what is missing, what looks wrong and what is misread. It AUDITS: it never gathers and it never authors the frame. No field here can carry a fact for the pack or a line of the frame's own prose, and a figure named inside a finding is a DOUBT for the capture session to chase to its source, never a fact that enters the record. The two echo fields bind the response to the exact evidence brief that was sent.

nonce_echo.description: The one-time token printed in the brief's header, echoed back verbatim.

capture_sha256_echo.description: The evidence hash printed in the brief's header, echoed back verbatim.

authored_frame.description: Always false: the auditor audits the frame, it never writes one.

findings.description: Every point against the evidence, each one self-contained. An empty list is a legitimate answer and means the evidence stands as it is.

id.description: Short stable id, unique in this response, e.g. E1.

kind.description: The five kinds, and nothing else: a decisive fact the pack does not carry; a value inconsistent, stale, mis-united or implausible; a frame that reads the business wrongly; a requirement the checklist should carry and does not; a figure read at its source that differs from the pack's.

severity.description: blocking: the council cannot honestly sit until this is answered. material: the answer could change. minor: worth recording.

detail.description: The point itself, at most 60 words, in plain English an investment manager reads without a glossary.

fact_ids.description: The ids in the pack this finding is about. Empty where the point is that no such fact exists.

where_it_likely_lives.description: For a missing fact: where it would be found - a named filing, an exhibit, an investor-relations page, a data vendor. Null otherwise.

source_url.description: For a source_doubt only: the one public page actually read. Null otherwise.

figure_at_source.description: For a source_doubt only: the figure as that page prints it, copied exactly. It is a doubt to be chased, never a fact; the capture session must capture it with its own source before it enters the record. Null otherwise.

overall.description: One paragraph on the evidence as a whole, rendered verbatim and attributed in the report. Null where the findings say everything.
